description.value: Sushi Aji is a neighbourhood Japanese restaurant on Kingsway in East Vancouver offering a broad menu of sushi rolls, nigiri, sashimi, oshi sushi, bento boxes, and hot dishes. The shop supports online ordering with a stated 15-minute pickup window, making it a practical quick stop. With nearly 300 customer reviews it appears to be a well-established local spot.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 30m; stands (2 spaces) at 55m; stands (2 spaces) at 66m; stands (2 spaces) at 78m; stands (4 spaces, covered) at 81m; stands (4 spaces, covered) at 87m; stands (2 spaces) at 91m. Total: 18 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the OSM address (3339 Kingsway, Vancouver, BC V5R5K6) and phone (+1 604-434-6319). The site has an active online ordering system advertising pickup, and the menu lists several explicitly vegetarian items (Vegetable Roll, Veggie Dragon Roll, Avocado Roll, Mango and Avocado Roll). No cycling-specific amenities — bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi — are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Sushi Aji is a legitimate, active food stop on a Vancouver arterial route with takeout capability, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website. A site visit or direct outreach is needed to verify these before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM survey date is 2021-10-26; website appears current (copyright 2026) and active with online ordering.
